name: Kitakyushu Quasi-National Park
description: Quasi-national park of the Kitakyushu mountains and coast: the Hiraodai karst plateau, the Sarakura peaks and the green ring of the industrial city.
notes: Managed by Fukuoka. Hiraodai's karst fields and the Sarakurayama ropeway are the highlights.
parking: Parking available at major visitor areas (fee varies)

ja.notes: 福岡県が管理。平尾台のカルスト地形と皿倉山ロープウェイが見どころ。
